theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lp_imc_suspension
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (Gh : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (N + 1)), (∀ (t : ℝ) (u : Euclid n), Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp (G u)))) → (∀ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L G → LipschitzWith (max 1 L) Gh) ∧ (∀ (m : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid n)), (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ (t t' : ℝ), ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ u' ∈ A, min 1 m * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)) : Euclid (n + 1)) - WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t' (WithLp.ofLp u'))‖ ≤ ‖Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) - Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t' (WithLp.ofLp u')))‖) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : Euclid n), DifferentiableAt ℝ G u → DifferentiableAt ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) ∧ (∀ (s : ℝ) (w : Euclid n), fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp w))) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp (fderiv ℝ G u w)))) ∧ (Injective (fderiv ℝ G u) → Injective (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))))) ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (N + 1)) = Submodule.span ℝ (insert (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) ((fun v : Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ G u : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid N) : Set (Euclid N)))) ∧ Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))
